comparison.objective: Merges an object into an available belt gap; candidate fractures and collects HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Gap prediction and synchronized placement differ from recessed coaxial alignment, bimanual hammer control, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Successful gap insertion is title-supported; timing/placement tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four valid fractures, full containment, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Temporal conveyor placement does not exercise the candidate’s fracture or recovery requirements.
